WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: flatten
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: True to flatten the layers into a single list; false to use the layer hierarchy.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: perLayerLinkedWcs
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: To enable Export/WebCoverageService for all WMS layers in this group, set perLayerLinkedWcs.linkedWcsUrl. linkedWcsCoverage will be set to the WMS layer Name if it is defined, layer Title otherwise.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: name
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: description
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: nameInCatalog
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: info
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReport
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReportSections
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideSource
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: metadataUrls
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataUrls
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataCustodian
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: modelDimensions
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: disableAboutData
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: shareable
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: getCapabilitiesUrl
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The URL at which to access to the OGC GetCapabilities service.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: getCapabilitiesCacheDuration
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The amount of time to cache GetCapabilities responses.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: excludeMembers
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of strings of excluded group and item names (or ids). A group or item name (or id) that appears in this list will not be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will also apply to all child/nested groups

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: includeMembersRegex
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: A regular expression that is matched against the member names and ids. Only members (groups and items) that match against the regular expression will be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will only apply to the first level of members (not in nested groups). This is applied before excludeMembers.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpen
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: True if this group is open and its contents are visible; otherwise, false.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: mergeGroupsByName
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Merge member groups by name.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: sortMembersBy
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Sort members by the given property/trait. For example name, will sort all members by alphabetically

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: members
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The members of this group.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: displayGroup
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Allow adding all members to the workbench with one click. Show Add All / Remove All button

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemProperties
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items (note - will not set traits to sub-groups). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Also see itemPropertiesByType and itemPropertiesByIds.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByType
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model type (eg csv or geojson). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per type.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByIds
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model ID. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per id.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: legends
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: url
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: forceProxy
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.name: cacheDuration
WebMapServiceCatalogGroupTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.name: linkedWcsUrl
ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.description: Gets or sets the URL of a WCS that enables clip-and-ship for this WMS item.

ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.name: linkedWcsCoverage
ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.description: Gets or sets the coverage name for linked WCS for clip-and-ship.

ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.name: linkedWcsParameters
ExportWebCoverageServiceTraits.description: WCS Parameters included in GetCoverage requests (for clip-and-ship).

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: outputFormat
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: File format of output (defaults to GeoTIFF).

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: subsets
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: Array of key-value pairs for subsets to be included in query parameters. For example {key: "Time", value: "2020"} will add query parameter subset=Time("2020")

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: duplicateSubsetValues
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: If multiple values have been detected for a particular subset ID (key), then we can only use the first one as WCS only supports one value per subset. Each element in this array represents the actual value used for a subset which has multiple values.

WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.name: additionalParameters
WebCoverageServiceParameterTraits.description: Each key-value will be added to URL like so - someurl.com?key=value.

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: type
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: The type of model to apply itemProperties to. This must be defined.

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified type. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: ids
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: The IDs of models to apply itemProperties to.

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified id. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.
